title: Create Tier with no name shows a required-field error
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Tier.
  3. Click Create Tier.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list shows the active tiers.

Step 2:

  • The new tier's page opens with an empty name.

Step 3:

  • Under the name field an error reads "Tier name is a required field".
  • The page stays on New Tier.
  • The field is outlined in red.
